title: Dutch doughnuts
hookLine: Global-inspired dutch doughnuts with 5 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Dutch doughnuts
steps.instructionTemplate: Place the flour in a large bowl and add the yeast and sugar. If the milk is cold make sure to heat it to lukewarm. Mix your flour mixture bit by bit with the milk until you have a smooth batter. Add the salt and mix with a wooden spoon till the batter is smooth and liquidy. Incorporate {m53393_1}, {m53393_2}, {m53393_3}, and {m53393_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Cover with a clean tea towel and leave in a warm spot for about an hour to rise. Combine until completely smooth, uniform, and free of lumps before moving to the next stage. Incorporate {m53393_5} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Portion, Shape & Layer Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat your deep fryer or add the oil to a large pot. The oil should be a t 180˚C (350˚F) for best results. Combine until completely smooth, uniform, and free of lumps before moving to the next stage.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Before starting stir your batter through and scoop the batter with two spoons or with an ice cream scoop. Let it drop into the oil carefully. It is easiest to do this if you dip your spoons or scoop into the oil before dipping into the batter. That way it will slide of the spoons easily. Don't over crowd the fryer to prevent the oil cooling down too quickly and everything sticking together. Once one side is golden brown it usually turns around to the other side automatically. If not help it along with two forks.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Garnish & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Take the balls out once golden brown and leave to drain on a piece of kitchen paper. Drain briefly on a wire cooling rack lined with paper towels for 1–2 minutes so the outside stays shatteringly crisp, then plate into 4 servings and enjoy warm.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.
